changelog: New Light Board category, built up component by component: Acrylic, ACP Sheet, Steel Letter, SS Letter, LED Module, Power Supply, Wire, Pipe & Frame, MS Frame, Installation / Fitting, Transport and Labour.

One order can now mix both kinds of line. Acrylic and ACP are asked as Quantity, Width, Height, Total Sq. Ft., Rate, Amount, while Steel Letter, LED Module, Power Supply, Wire and Labour just ask Quantity, Unit, Rate, Amount — in the same order.
Every component keeps its own unit (pcs, sqft, ft, mtr, job), shown on the order line and on the printed bill.
Not on the list? Choose Custom and type any component name you like.
The grand total updates the moment a component is added, edited or deleted — the same single calculation used everywhere.

Components are fully manageable from the Categories screen: add, rename, reorder, change a component between Qty × Rate and ft × ft, or remove it. No programming needed, and it applies to any category, not just Light Board.
